مَجَالٌ A place in which one goes round, or about, or round about: (TA:) [a field of battle: a circus:] a place of exercise for horses. (Har p. 16.) ―
-b2- [Hence] one says, لَمْ يَبْقَ مَجَالٌ فِى الأَمْرِ (tropical:) [There remained not any scope in the affair, or case]. (TA.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
